summary: The US team has no title partner. Its published partner block is Tommy Hilfiger (PVH) as apparel partner plus Crypto.com|OG, Luxury Group Marriott, AG1, Amazon, CîROC (Diageo), Apex, Leyton, Bermuda Tourism Authority, Beatbot, Barton & Gray, Zhik and Nomadix, each documented by a team or company announcement.
